uploads.photoGuidance: HEIF/HEIC, JPEG/JPG or PNG. Up to {{max}} photos. Pick them straight off your phone or camera — large photos are optimized automatically and stored under 1 MB.
uploads.cameraGuidance: For smaller originals, use High Efficiency (HEIF/HEIC) on a supported iPhone or Android camera. File sizes vary; HEIC is converted to JPEG for browser compatibility.
uploads.documentGuidance: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC. We compress each file to under 1 MB.
uploads.pdfGuidance: Signed PDFs must already be under 1 MB, as compressing them breaks the signature. Documents are optional for publishing.

misc1.plansFaq1A: Each contact is a request you send to an owner. Once they approve it, you see their phone number and reach out directly — no broker in between. You get 15 free contacts to use within 30 days of your first one, each friend you refer who qualifies adds 15 more, and a Contact Pack ({{fee}}) adds {{count}} for {{days}} days.
misc1.plansFaq2A: No. Contact Packs, Listing Passes and rent agreements are one-time payments. Nothing auto-renews — you pay only when you choose to.
misc1.plansFaq3A: Correct. Draazy never charges brokerage — you deal directly with verified owners.
misc1.plansFaq4Q: What does a rent agreement cost?
misc1.plansFaq4A: Our platform fee is just {{fee}}, plus government charges (stamp duty & registration). It is the same for a first agreement or a renewal.
misc1.plansFaq5Q: What does a second live listing cost?
misc1.plansFaq5A: Your first live listing is free. Each extra live listing needs a Listing Pass — {{fee}} for {{days}} days. You can also pause another listing to free the slot.
